none: PAS KENT-9BF1C6: A scattered horad of four silver and two gold ingots. Treasure case 2009 T181.
contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Gold and silver hoard of probable Roman date. 1. Gold 'finger' ingot. Rectangular shape, flat on the underside, truncated planoconvex in profile; the terminal ends are rounded and the sides bevelled from the flat upper surface. There are a series of visible hammer marks in a number of places on the surface, but no stamps or inscriptions. L.: 70.4mm W.: 17.2mm thickness: 7.1mm Wt.: 113.9g AV…
